asserts.name: instantSettlesLive
asserts.detail: Live Instant snapshot, not fail-closed Memory readyCounter(0). Live Instant snapshot via websocket:wss://api.instantdb.com/runtime/session?app_id=5417c2e3-c6b9-476d-a962-2e11c83492aa.

asserts.name: countVisible
asserts.detail: Number is visible on the painted Counter page. count 0 visible with plus and minus.

asserts.name: incrementRaises
asserts.detail: Plus raises the visible count by 1. 0 -> 1.

asserts.name: decrementLowers
asserts.detail: Minus lowers the visible count by 1. 1 -> 0.

asserts.name: actionMenuAbstraction
asserts.detail: Action menu abstraction is on screen. Overlay not visible after cmd-K or ?.

asserts.name: sameScreenMirrored
asserts.detail: Already-painted hosts show the same counterScreen. https://counter-mobile.knophy.com missing counterScreen. Proof remains https://counter.knophy.com.

asserts.name: globalSync
asserts.detail: Shared Instant count, not per-user login. second context saw -3. Not login.

asserts.name: offlineWorks
asserts.detail: Painted Counter still increments with the network offline. offline plus raised -4 -> -3.
